section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces 'The Present Study', which aims to evaluate the conceptual equivalence and factor structure of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) in a large sample of adults in Hong Kong. The study will examine the fit of various one- and two-dimensional models of the BAS, investigate its construct validity through associations with BMI and self-esteem, and analyze sex differences in body appreciation. Hong Kong is highlighted as a relevant non-Western setting due to its increasing obesity rates and negative body image issues, alongside cultural differences from Western contexts.
